title: [M1] A pending permission prompt never gets an Approve: the row reads 'running 0s', then disappears at 120 s while the dialog is still up
repro: kestrel idle at its prompt; send its arm prompt (asks to run ./deploy.sh --dry-run with Bash)
Open Home (one click on Net)
Watch kestrel's row for 130 s
expected: Within ≤3 s of the dialog, kestrel's row says it needs approval for 'Bash: ./deploy.sh --dry-run' and offers Approve (and Deny).
actual: 2 of 2 episodes: row 'kestrel · 0s' appeared 0.5–0.8 s after the registry flip as RUNNING (green) with only ▶ ✓ ◎; it counted up as running and was removed at +120.6 s / +120.9 s while the registry still said waiting(permission prompt). Approve was never offered (~240 s watched). Claude Code kept the pending tool_use out of the transcript (last record = the prompt); the registry had status+waitingFor within 2 s.
truth: registry waiting(permission prompt) since 01:54:40.8Z and 02:03:49.4Z; pane: 'Do you want to proceed? 1. Yes 2. Yes, and don't ask again for: ./deploy.sh * 3. No'; transcript last record = user prompt (tool_use withheld)

title: [M2] AskUserQuestion cannot be answered from the pet: no question, no options, no Reply; the row reads running and vanishes at 120 s
repro: beacon idle; send its arm prompt (AskUserQuestion: which database)
Open Home
Watch beacon's row for 130 s
expected: A 'needs you' row with the question and its options (SQLite / Postgres / Redis / Type something), answerable in ≤2 clicks.
actual: Row 'beacon · 0s' read RUNNING with ▶ ✓ ◎ only; no question text, options or Reply at any point; removed at +120.0 s while the registry still said waiting(input needed). The only blocked-row action in the code is Approve = Enter on the highlighted option; its send-to probe for beacon returned "couldn't find its tab" (87 ms).
truth: registry waiting(input needed) since 01:54:41.4Z; pane: 'Which database should beacon use to store check results? 1. SQLite 2. Postgres 3. Redis 4. Type something. 5. Chat about this'; transcript last record = user prompt

title: [M10][M12] Approve and Reply cannot reach a tmux-hosted session: send-to answers "couldn't find its tab" and nothing is delivered
repro: Prompt kestrel to end its turn with a yes/no question (row turns 'needs' with Reply)
Click Reply, type 'yes', press Enter (x3)
IPC probe of Approve's call: send-to(kestrel, null)
expected: The reply lands in kestrel's session (new user record, new turn); Approve presses Enter in kestrel's pane.
actual: 3 of 3 replies: note "Couldn't send: couldn't find its tab" 133/211/136 ms after Enter; 0 new transcript records; registry stayed idle. Approve's send-to returned the same {ok:false} for kestrel (89 ms) and beacon (87 ms). The sessions run under a tmux server with no .app ancestor (GUI host = null), which is the only host send-to knows.
truth: end_turn 'Should the deploy script have unit tests?' at 02:00:09.6Z; registry idle; tmux vp-kestrel pane %8

title: [M11] Jump never reaches a tmux session: terminal not raised, tmux client not switched, and it copies `claude --resume <id>` for live sessions
repro: Have a Terminal.app window with a tmux client attached to the fleet (kestrel's session)
Open Home
Click the title of each row (6 members x3)
expected: ≤1 s: Terminal comes forward with its tmux client on that session's pane.
actual: 18 of 18 jumps returned {ok:false} (click→result median 154 ms); frontmost app unchanged 18/18; the tmux client stayed on kestrel for jumps to beacon/atlas/delta/ember/vibepet; each wrote `cd ~/.vibepet-ultra/fleet/<member> && claude --resume <session-id>` to the clipboard (recorded) — for the live sessions (kestrel, beacon, atlas, delta, vibepet) that would start a second claude on the same session.
truth: kestrel waiting(permission prompt), beacon waiting(input needed), atlas busy (build.sh), delta busy (fan-out), vibepet idle, ember exited; tmux client /dev/ttys012 on vp-kestrel

title: [T2] Row-action feedback goes to the bubble, which is drawn behind the open Home panel (jump failures, 'goal hit', level-up)
repro: Open Home
Click a row (jump fails) or press ✓ on a goal
Look for the result
expected: Failures and confirmations show where the user is looking: in the row or the panel.
actual: Jump failure text "<member>: couldn't find its terminal — resume command copied" was occluded by the panel in 18 of 18 jumps (element on top at the bubble's centre = #chat); nothing appeared in the panel. 'goal hit … +15xp' and 'LEVEL 3! unlocked: sparkle trail' were also behind the panel.
truth: each jump returned {ok:false}; goal_done ledger entries written

title: Reply box steals focus on every 3 s redraw: words typed in the chat bar land in a session's reply box
repro: A session ends its turn with a question (row 'needs' with Reply)
Click Reply (reply box opens)
Click into the chat input and type 'what is atlas doing' at a normal pace (~7 s)
expected: The text stays in the chat input; an open reply box never takes focus on its own.
actual: Chat input ended with 'what '; 'is atlas doing' landed in kestrel's reply box after the next redraw moved focus there mid-word. Pressing Enter would send those words to kestrel as its answer (on a GUI terminal: typed into the session).
truth: kestrel idle after asking 'Should the deploy script have unit tests?'

title: The 3 s redraw wipes row interaction state: a click spanning it is dropped, keyboard focus on a row button falls to <body>, text selection is cleared
repro: Home with a row visible
(a) Press ◎ and release 3.3 s later (spans a redraw); repeat with a 120 ms click
(b) Shift+Tab from the chat input to a row button, wait 3 s, press Enter
(c) Drag-select the row's goal text, wait 3.4 s
expected: A redraw that changes nothing keeps pending clicks, focus and selection.
actual: (a) 0 of 2 held clicks took effect; 2 of 2 normal clicks did. (b) Focus moved to <body> at the first redraw (2977 ms after focusing); Enter then did nothing. (c) Selection gone within 3.4 s. Any hand click that happens to straddle a tick (~3% of 100 ms clicks) is silently lost.
truth: vibepet idle, turn finished 02:12:19Z

title: Selecting text in a row fires a jump (and a failed jump overwrites the clipboard with a resume command)
repro: Home with a row visible
Drag across the row's goal/ask text to select it
expected: Text is selected; no jump.
actual: The drag counted as a row click: 1 jump call. On tmux that jump fails and writes `cd … && claude --resume <id>` to the clipboard, replacing what the user meant to copy; the selection itself is wiped by the next redraw.
truth: vibepet idle
